project.new.notes: The 'Blank video' tile has no accessible name; scoped CSS on its role=option container

editor.getting_started_close.notes: Shown on a new Vid ('Getting started' dialog); absent afterwards

project.title.notes: input.docs-title-input; Enter commits; persists across reload

generate.open_panel.notes: aria-disabled='true' in a Vid with no scene (observed); the adapter refuses

generate.prompt.notes: the AI video prompt (contenteditable). Its label changes once an ingredient is attached ('Specify how you want to use the ingredients…') and it then starts with a non-editable 'Image1' chip; type after it. enterkeyhint=send: NEVER press Enter here

generate.settings.notes: aria-label e.g. 'Generation settings: Omni, 720p, Landscape, 10 sec' (09-30; '6 seconds' on 09-29) is the read-back

generate.ingredients.notes: opens a native file chooser (observed 2026-09-30, neutral test image, nothing submitted)

generate.submit.notes: natively disabled with an empty prompt (observed; the adapter refuses before clicking); enabled with text, no client-side prompt limit seen up to 4559 characters. The panel's inspiration gallery has 'Recreate inspiration gallery item N' buttons: never clicked (they may generate)

menu.file.download_mp4.notes: Located only; download not performed (needs a generated video)

generate.in_progress.notes: shown with a percentage while generating (observed ~60 s for 6 s)

generate.ready.value: Your generated video is ready for preview

generate.result.notes: aria-label 'Generated video: <prompt>, 720p, 6 seconds'; 1280x720, 6.016 s observed. Exists only in the open page until inserted

generate.result.insert.notes: '← Insert' under the result. Observed 2026-09-30: fills the SELECTED blank scene (1 scene 5.0 s → 1 scene 6.0 s); does not append a scene

text.add_title.notes: adds a box reading 'Title' to the ACTIVE scene; it persists

captions.open.notes: panel: 'Apply to' radios All scenes / Current scene, ~30 style presets, More → Edit transcript / Delete all captions (never clicked)

timeline.duration.notes: total length as mm:ss.f; parent aria 'X seconds out of Y seconds.'. Empty Vid 00:00.0; one blank scene 00:05.0 (observed)

timeline.new_scene.notes: the '+' at the right of the timeline (as the user directs): adds a blank 5.0 s scene AFTER the active one and makes it active. The toolbar #newSceneButton does the same

canvas.video.notes: the ACTIVE scene's clip; other scenes' videos stay in the DOM hidden (0 px). The AI panel result is 'Generated video: …'

timeline.scene_group.notes: one per scene: the scene button, its page number and its duration label

timeline.scene_duration.notes: seconds with one decimal ('5.0' blank, '6.0' for the 6.016 s clip); in the DOM with timing shown or hidden

timeline.scene_active.notes: the active scene's rect; clicking a scene makes it active; not saved (reopen = scene 1)

timeline.new_scene_empty.notes: the canvas 'Click to add a new scene' control of a Vid with no scene (0 px wide otherwise)

text.canvas_text.notes: text on the canvas only (the filmstrip copies are g#filmstrip-…); one <text> per word/line; an invisible hit-area path overlays it, so clicks are forced; other scenes' text stays in the DOM hidden after visiting them, so only :visible text is the active scene's

text.selection.notes: the highlight drawn over selected text (after double-clicking the word); the adapter requires it to overlap the word

text.format_bold.notes: NOT a signal: with the Text side panel open the text buttons overflow into '⋮'

captions.style_first.value: .docsWizSidebarSidebarContainer button[aria-label^="Bold white text with a purple emphasis"]
captions.style_first.notes: selecting a style marks it pressed; captions are generated from spoken audio only

captions.no_speech.value: Add media with spoken audio to generate captions
captions.no_speech.notes: banner shown after choosing a style in a Vid without spoken audio

text.add_body.notes: adds a centred box reading 'Body text' (two <text> words) to the ACTIVE scene; triple-click selects both; typed text wraps; punctuation types as is

canvas.image.notes: images on the ACTIVE scene's canvas (blob: href); filmstrip copies are under g#filmstrip-…

format.x.value: input[aria-label^="X-position, measured in pixels"], input[aria-label^="X position, measured in pixels"]
format.x.notes: 'X-position, …' (account 1) / 'X position, …' (account 2); from top left; canvas 1920x1080; fill then Tab commits

format.y.value: input[aria-label^="Y-position, measured in pixels"], input[aria-label^="Y position, measured in pixels"]

generate.ingredients_more.notes: replaces 'Ingredients' once an image is attached

generate.ingredient_remove.notes: one per attached ingredient image: the attachment read-back

generate.quota.value: You've hit your limits for generating videos in Vids
generate.quota.notes: shown in place of the result after Generate once the account's generation limit is reached (observed after 3 generations on account 1); offers 'Try again' / 'Remove' - never clicked

generate.insert_new_scene.notes: shown in a 'Previewing' box when Insert is pressed while the active scene already holds a clip; adds the clip as a new scene after it (observed, account 2)
